leaves.rawValue: Below you will find several DEATH GUARD Detachments you can select from to use in games of Warhammer 40,000, as described in the Core Rules (see the Select Detachment Rules step).
leaves.justification: Explains permitted Detachment choice, scope/restrictions, Character Enhancements or Stratagem access/CP use; preserve factual instruction without implementing executable legality.

leaves.rawValue: Each Detachment is a themed fighting force that focuses on one particular combat style employed by the Death Guard - the rules they include are as follows:
leaves.justification: Describes the theme/combat style and introduces section layout; imposes no rule, restriction or effect.

leaves.rawValue: The Detachment rule listed here will apply to either your whole army or to particular units within it.
leaves.justification: Explains permitted Detachment choice, scope/restrictions, Character Enhancements or Stratagem access/CP use; preserve factual instruction without implementing executable legality.

leaves.rawValue: If any additional restrictions or benefits apply to a Detachment, they will be listed here.
leaves.justification: States where additional restrictions/benefits would be listed; it neither defines a restriction nor grants a benefit.

leaves.rawValue: This can include units your army either must include or cannot include, as well as additional keywords some of your units may gain.
leaves.justification: Explains permitted Detachment choice, scope/restrictions, Character Enhancements or Stratagem access/CP use; preserve factual instruction without implementing executable legality.

leaves.rawValue: When mustering your army, your chosen Detachment enables you to upgrade CHARACTERS using the Enhancements listed here, as described in the Core Rules (see the Select Units step).
leaves.justification: Explains permitted Detachment choice, scope/restrictions, Character Enhancements or Stratagem access/CP use; preserve factual instruction without implementing executable legality.

leaves.rawValue: Your chosen Detachment gives you access to the Stratagems listed here in addition to the Core Stratagems listed in the Core Rules.
leaves.justification: Explains permitted Detachment choice, scope/restrictions, Character Enhancements or Stratagem access/CP use; preserve factual instruction without implementing executable legality.

leaves.rawValue: During the battle, you can spend Command points (CP) to use these Stratagems.
leaves.justification: Explains permitted Detachment choice, scope/restrictions, Character Enhancements or Stratagem access/CP use; preserve factual instruction without implementing executable legality.

leaves.rawValue: You can find out more about how to use Stratagems here.
leaves.justification: Publisher instruction to follow an explanatory link; imposes no gameplay rule.

leaves.rawValue: Mortarion's Hammer Detachment, Stinking Mire Stratagem, Target and Effect Sections
leaves.justification: Together the scope heading and Change to directive identify a replacement of the accepted TARGET and EFFECT, rather than an additive rule.
